findings.title: The dry-run log header gives the wrong code commit
findings.verdict_reasoning:
I checked the claim against git and it holds. It is a low-severity provenance error.

What the log says: the first line of results_v3/logs/hpc_dry_run.log names `commit 799b214` and the time 2026-10-03T02:58:59+02:00. hpc/dry_run_v3.sh fills that field with `git rev-parse --short HEAD`. 799b214 was committed at 02:52:55 and 00c2c4a not until 03:26:45, so HEAD really was 799b214 when the dry run ran.

This is a real provenance defect in a committed artifact. handoff.md (around lines 762 and 913) and hpc/README_v3.md (lines 107-108) both point to this log as evidence for the cluster package. No reported number is affected, so the severity stays low.
